entries.category: Release Available: Client Connector 5.0.2 for iOS
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 5.0.2 Enhancements and Fixes
entries.text:
Fixes an issue where Private Access search domains weren’t getting applied to Private Access DNS settings.
Fixes an issue that caused TCP connections to time out after 20 seconds without data activity.

entries.category: Release Available: Client Connector 5.0.1 for iOS
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 5.0.1 Enhancements and Fixes
entries.text: Fixes an issue where the Ownership posture type failed during login and reauthentication after upgrading to iOS version 5.0 with the modernized Zscaler Client Connector UI. To learn more, see the trust post.

entries.title: Canada Isolation Region Updated to Montreal
entries.text:
The Canada region, available when configuring Internet & SaaS (ZIA) isolation profiles, was updated to Montreal.
To learn more, see Creating Isolation Profiles for Internet & SaaS.

entries.title: Support for VPN (For Legacy Apps) Border Gateway Protocol Configuration
entries.text:
You can configure enhanced Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) routing options including support for summary routes and the ability to advertise local network segments while BGP is enabled. These enhancements are designed to streamline network deployments and provide greater routing flexibility, especially for organizations with large address spaces.
To learn more, see About Summary Routes.

entries.title: Canada Isolation Region Updated to Montreal
entries.text:
The Canada region, available when configuring Private Access (ZPA) isolation profiles, was updated to Montreal.
To learn more, see Creating Isolation Profiles for Private Access.

entries.title: App Connector Version 26.59.2
entries.text:
